source_contract: Browser toolbox getSandboxMounts maps att to attachments.agentBlobDir(agentId); sandbox/ipc.ts defines READ_ONLY_PERMISSIONS as read and list. Native agent-core path-resolution.ts also reserves att as a read-only static mount.

behavior.root: One broker is permanently bound to one host-selected chat ID and data directory. AttachmentStore::agentDirectory supplies dataDir/attachments/<agentId>, shared by imported originals and API.createAttachment. The separate attachment-snapshots/<agentId> directory is not mounted.
behavior.read: Sandbox fsPromises/node:fs readFile on att/<blob> returns exact Buffer bytes by default or bounded strict UTF-8 when requested. AttachmentStore validates the final opened Windows file handle and reads from that same handle. Empty files, BOM and newline bytes are preserved; binary bytes are never passed through a text conversion.
behavior.list: fsPromises/node:fs readdir accepts att or att/ and lists the flat owned blob namespace from a validated pinned Windows directory handle. Recursive produces the same flat entries. Captured names are checked without reopening paths; unexpected directories/links or invalid names are rejected. Same-handle enumeration prevents alias-retarget mixing but is not an atomic snapshot of mutable directory contents.
behavior.permissions: fs writeFile and mkdir to att are rejected before the ordinary file executor receives them. The broker independently rejects every operation except readFile, readBytes and readDirectory, and rejects a foreign agent identity. Traversal, invalid blob names, Windows device/ADS syntax, missing files and junction roots fail through AttachmentStore validation.
behavior.lifecycle: Requests run through a zero-delay queued dispatch and unique generation. Cancellation removes ownership before completion, obsolete callbacks cannot finish a reused ID, and cancelAll tolerates destruction from a completion observer. AgentToolHost cancels these requests on context reset, workspace reset and teardown. Valid generated attachments remain readable immediately by their returned att filename.
behavior.invalid_storage: A failed owned-root validation disables the SandboxHost artifact directory explicitly. API.createAttachment then errors instead of using its standalone default global artifact path.

verification.scope: Independent native static Qt stage built from copied sources before migration. Fixtures use temporary files, two actual AgentToolHost instances and the actual native QuickJS worker; no live provider or external website. Parent integrated results are recorded separately.
cases: Original bytes differ from a stored history snapshot and raw att reads still return originals
API-generated binary attachment immediately reads back
att bytes copied into apps without a workspace
UTF-8/BOM/empty files and explicit oversized errors
Two chats with the same blob filename read distinct bytes
Queued cancellation and ignored late reply
Reused request IDs and broker deletion during cancelAll
Invalid owned root cannot fall back to global artifact storage
Nested junction and replaced attachment root fail closed

remaining_gaps: Native model formatted read/ls routing for att is separate from this sandbox bridge
Files above the binary/text bounds require future chunked or streaming APIs
Full Node fs methods, sync calls, encodings, flags and error-code parity remain incomplete
Additional sandbox mounts such as plugins/logs/memory/shells and stable multiple workspaces are not implemented
